G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero #155
"A Letter from Snake-Eyes"
Release date: October 18, 1994
Cover date: December, 1994
Continues in A Real American Hero #155½, where it's currently published to this day.

Notes

  • Following issue 155, Marvel released one more issue the following month, G.I. Joe: Special #1. It contains new artwork by Todd McFarlane for issue 61. Originally Todd McFarlane drew the issue but was fired when Larry Hama didn't feel he was right for the book.
  • After issue 155, the series would lay dormant for sixteen years, before being revived by IDW Publishing for another 145 issues. It was revived again in November 2023 with #301 by Image Comics/Skybound Entertainment.
